subject: Request: Pilot support allocation for BlueNova Systems — trial extension + usage cap
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Emma Liu <emma@bluenova.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Pilot support allocation for BlueNova Systems — trial extension + usage cap

Hi Laura / Monica —

BlueNova (Emma + Megan on cc) are in the middle of a 30-day pilot that started strong during evaluation, but they just ran into a burst usage event because their data ingestion ramped earlier than expected. They asked whether we can: 1) extend the trial window by an additional 45 days, and 2) provide a one-time consumption buffer of 150k tokens (billed to a deferred pilot credit) so their engineers can complete integration and share feedback.

Quick context: BlueNova is a seed-stage ML infra company focusing on medical imaging search (high token rate during indexing). Their current pilot is tied to a potential Dedicated deal (high intent) — HubSpot deal DL-2027-00433. If we give a short-term buffer and extension, their CTO has signaled they'll move to a paid POC with committed capacity in Q4.

Ask: can we approve a 45-day extension + 150k token pilot credit as a discretionary sales exception? If yes, any preferred wording for the SOW / DocuSign? I attached the draft SOW and pilot metrics they requested.

Attachments: Bluenova_SOW_draft.pdf, pilot-metrics.xlsx

Thanks — I can sync with finance and legal as needed.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Emma Liu <emma@bluenova.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Pilot support allocation for BlueNova Systems — trial extension + usage cap

Jordan — thanks for the context. High level: I’m supportive of a measured extension if it materially increases the probability of conversion. A couple of constraints we should follow:

- Limit the credit to a one-time pilot buffer of up to 150k tokens, explicitly refundable to the pool if unused.
- Extension up to 45 days, with a milestone (ingestion + 2 model-run demos) that must be completed by day 30 of the extension or the extension terminates.
- Legal should approve the SOW language that mentions the credit as a promotional allowance, not a service credit.

Monica — can you confirm if Finance needs a formal approval ticket or if you can process this under the Sales promo allowance workflow?

Emma — appreciate the quick turnaround on the SOW. Can you confirm the expected token draw pattern so we can size the buffer correctly?

Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Emma Liu <emma@bluenova.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 08:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Pilot support allocation for BlueNova Systems — pilot credit processing note

Laura / Jordan — looping in finance workflow: we can process this as a "Pilot Promotion" under the sales discretionary budget up to $1,200 equivalent (150k tokens at current rate). I need an approved deal note and the SOW flagged as "promo-backed". Steps I need from you:

1) Signed SOW (DocuSign link preferred) or an email confirmation from the customer's CEO approving the pilot extension.
2) A short internal approval note (Laura ok to reply-all with final wording).
3) Please confirm the exact token amount to reserve so Finance can create the internal credit line.

Also note: because BlueNova is in healthcare-adjacent workflows, we should include the standard data handling checkbox (they've indicated no PHI in the current pilot, but we should document it).

I can fast-track once we have the SOW + confirmation.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

From: Emma Liu <emma@bluenova.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 11:44:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: Pilot support allocation for BlueNova Systems — pilot extension + usage cap

Hi Jordan / Laura / Monica —

Thanks for the quick responses. Confirming: BlueNova is happy with a 45-day extension and the proposed milestone cadence (we can commit to ingestion + two demo runs by day 30). Token expectation: initial spike ~90k tokens during ingestion (indexing images + metadata enrichment), then ~15-20k tokens/week for model evaluation. So 150k is a comfortable buffer.

I attached the signed SOW (placeholder) and a short note from Megan (CTO) authorizing the extension — we can route a DocuSign later, but consider this our email OK to proceed.

Attachments: Bluenova_SOW_draft.pdf (signed_placeholder), pilot-metrics.xlsx

Emma Liu
Head of Product — BlueNova Systems
emma@bluenova.ai

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma@bluenova.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 14:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Pilot support allocation for BlueNova Systems — pilot extension + usage cap

All — quick update: Laura approved the terms below (see her earlier reply) and Finance confirmed they can allocate the promotional credit once we have the signed SOW in DocuSign format. Emma — would you be able to route the SOW through DocuSign today? Once DocuSign is complete we'll provision the 150k token buffer and flip the trial to the extended window.

Operational notes for the provisioning team: please reserve a promo credit labeled "Bluenova Pilot — DL-2027-00433" for 150000 tokens, expiry 2027-10-08 (45 days from approval). Set milestone check on 2027-09-21 (day 30).

Rishi — tagging you for any latency/throughput considerations; BlueNova mentioned heavy multi-image indexing during ingestion. If we need to suggest a lower-latency routing (dedicated pool trial) we can propose a burst window.

Emma / Megan — appreciate the partnership. I’ll follow up with the DocuSign link and the HubSpot update shortly.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
